## About
Harmony Pet Clinic is a full-service clinic for dogs and cats in Tomball, led by Dr. Raj Banga and Dr. Jaclyn Alba. Dr. Banga's love of animals began on his family's farm, and Dr. Alba is a graduate of the Texas A&M College of Veterinary Medicine.
We see pets for yearly wellness exams and vaccines, sickness, surgery, dental cleanings and emergencies. We have an in-house lab, digital x-rays and an in-house pharmacy, so a lot of what your pet needs can happen under one roof.
Families come to us from Tomball, Spring, The Woodlands, Magnolia and Cypress. We treat your pets like we would our own.

## Services
- Wellness exams and vaccines: A detailed nose to tail exam for every pet, plus vaccines for dogs and cats at every life stage and options for heartworm, flea and tick prevention.
- Urgent and emergency care: Urgent and emergency cases are seen on priority, including allergic reactions, injuries, wounds, heat stroke, breathing problems and seizures.
- Surgery: Spays and neuters, tumor removals, biopsies, bladder stone surgery, wound repairs, eye surgery, ear hematoma, hernia repairs and more, with attention to pain control.
- Dental cleaning under anesthesia: Cleaning with an ultrasonic scaler and polishing, extractions if needed, and certain oral surgeries.
- Skin and ear infections: Help for itching, allergies and ear infections, with allergy testing when it makes sense for your pet.
- Geriatric and arthritic care: Support for older pets dealing with arthritis, weight gain, and hearing or vision changes.
- In-house lab and digital x-rays: Blood work, urine tests and x-rays to help find what is going on inside, with outside lab support when needed.
- In-house pharmacy: Commonly prescribed medications, including injectables and heartworm prevention, available right at the clinic.
- Microchips and health certificates

## FAQ
Q: Do you take walk-ins?
A: Yes. We accept both walk-ins and scheduled appointments.

Q: Are you taking new patients?
A: Yes, we are accepting new clients. Please fill out the New Client Form any time before your first appointment.

Q: Can you handle emergencies?
A: Yes. We are able to handle emergencies, so call us and come in.
